title: SessionRecord
description: One user answer. correct must equal (given == answer) and can be recomputed on import to verify integrity.

answer.description: The correct direction, copied from QuestionDefinition.answer at answer time.

correct.description: Must equal (given == answer). Clients may recompute this on import.

responseMs.description: Time from question display to answer lock, in milliseconds.

answeredAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the answer was locked.

description: Unknown fields must be ignored to allow future display metadata without breaking older clients.
